items.title: Not all CISA-linked alerts are urgent: ASUS Live Update CVE-2025-59374
items.description: An ASUS Live Update vulnerability tracked as CVE-2025-59374 has been making the rounds in infosec feeds, with some headlines implying recent or ongoing exploitation. A closer look, however, shows the CVE documents a historic supply-chain attack in an End-of-Life (EoL) software product, not a new attack. [...]

items.description: Threat actors are now targeting Microsoft 365 accounts using a growing attack method known as OAuth device code phishing. This technique takes advantage of the OAuth 2.0 device authorization flow, a legitimate Microsoft feature designed for devices with limited input options. items.title: 125,000 IPs WatchGuard Firebox Devices Exposed to Internet Vulnerable to 0-day RCE Attacks
items.description: The Shadowserver Foundation identified approximately 125,000 WatchGuard Firebox firewall devices worldwide at risk due to a critical vulnerability actively exploited.
